description: This file defines testing extension methods for CanvasWindowController, providing utility functions for session key sanitization, JS string literals, frame storage, IPv4 parsing, and network checks, within debug compilation condition.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension adding testing utility methods to CanvasWindowController within debug configurations.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Tests the sanitizeSessionKey function with a given key.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Tests the jsStringLiteral function with a given string.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Tests the jsOptionalStringLiteral function with an optional string.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates a stored frame defaults key based on session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores a frame and loads it back, for testing frame persistence.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into four bytes.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address tuple is in the local network range.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is within the local network.
